hints.en: Inside `try:` call `requests.get(BASE + "/slow", timeout=1)`; print the message inside `except requests.Timeout:`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

try:
    requests.get(BASE + "/slow", timeout=1)
except requests.Timeout:
    print("too slow: gave up after 1 second")

r = requests.get(BASE + "/slow", timeout=5)
print("status:", r.status_code)
print("ok:", r.json()["ok"])
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

try:
    requests.get(BASE + "/slow", timeout=1)
except requests.Timeout:
    print("too slow: gave up after 1 second")

r = requests.get(BASE + "/slow", timeout=5)
print("status:", r.status_code)
print("ok:", r.json()["ok"])
```
